data.content: List me 20 chemicals which are more than 10x more toxic in fish than in algae and daphnia.

args.query: List up to 20 chemicals for which the species-specific observed toxic concentration for fish is at least 10 times lower (i.e., >10x more toxic) than for both algae and daphnia/crustaceans. Return the chemical names and the respective observed toxic concentrations per species used for this comparison.

            MATCH (s:Substance)
MATCH (s)-[tf:TESTED_FOR_TOXICITY]->(:Species {name: 'fish'})

MATCH (s)-[tc:TESTED_FOR_TOXICITY]->(:Species {name: 'crustacean'})

     min(tf.tox_value_mg_L) AS tox_fish,
     min(ta.tox_value_mg_L) AS tox_algae,
     min(tc.tox_value_mg_L) AS tox_crustacean
WHERE tox_fish IS NOT NULL AND tox_algae IS NOT NULL AND tox_crustacean IS NOT NULL
